answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. By the quartz of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the umber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
